columns.Description: Remove all Poison from an ally and afflict the nearest enemy with it.
Remove all Poison from an ally and heal them for the stacks removed.
Gain 3 energy. Returns to your hand.
Deal 3 damage and apply Vulnerable to an enemy within 6 tiles.
Move one tile in any direction.
Move up to two tiles in any direction.
Move up to three tiles in any direction, ignoring walls.
Deal 8 damage to everything within 1 tile.
Summon a line of Heavy Bandits.
Deal 4 damage. Gain 10 Shield and 2 Block.
Deal 5 damage to everything within 1 tile.
Deal 3 damage. Apply Weaken and Vulnerable.
Deal 6 damage. Gain 5 Shield. Gain 2 Block.
Deal 1 damage and apply Weaken to everything within 1 tile.
Deal 1 damage and apply 3 Poison to everything within 1 tile.
Apply 3 Poison to everything within 1 tile.
Deal 4 damage and apply Vulnerable within 1 tile.
Deal 2 damage. At the start of their next turn, the target discards a card at random.
Deal 2 damage. The target has 1 less energy for 2 turns.
Deal 7 damage to everything within 1 tile.
Deal 3 damage and apply Weaken to everything within 1 tile.
Move one tile in any direction.
Move to any tile on the board.
Create a Wall of Flames, anything standing ontop will take 4 damage.
Create a Wall of Force, stopping all movement through that area.
Draw a card, then discard a card.
For 2 turns, enemies cannot target you.
For 3 turns, your attacks apply 1 Poison.
Swap places with any character within 3 tiles.

glossary.title: STRENGTH
glossary.body: Adds 3 damage to the next {stacks} attacks.

glossary.title: DOUBLE ATTACK
glossary.body: The next {stacks} attack this character makes deals double damage.

glossary.title: POISON
glossary.body: Deals damage equal to {stacks} at the end of the turn.

glossary.title: FROZEN
glossary.body: Cannot act for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: SHIELD
glossary.body: Absorbs the next {stacks} damage. Only lasts for this turn.

glossary.title: BLOCK
glossary.body: Reduces damage taken by 3 for {stacks} turns

glossary.title: PARRY
glossary.body: Negates all damage and reflects the damage back for the next {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: ROOTED
glossary.body: This character is unable to use move actions for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: DOUBLE SHIELD
glossary.body: The next {stacks} Shields this character gains is doubled.

glossary.title: DODGE
glossary.body: Dodges the next attack and moves away. Lasts for the next {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: WEAKEN
glossary.body: Reduces the damage dealt by this character for the next {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: TAUNT
glossary.body: This character must move toward or attack the source of the Taunt for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: POISON BLADE
glossary.body: For {stacks} more turns, every attack this character lands also applies {amount} Poison.

glossary.title: STEALTH
glossary.body: Enemies cannot target this character for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: VULNERABLE
glossary.body: Increase the damage taken by 3 for the next {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: EMPOWERED
glossary.body: Multiplies {status} granted to all {targets} in range by {amount}.

glossary.title: POTENT
glossary.body: Adds {amount} to the potency of {status} for all {targets} in range.

glossary.title: STANDING WARD
glossary.body: Grants {amount} {status} to all {targets} in range {timing}.

glossary.title: SUMMONED
glossary.body: Will die in {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: REGENERATION
glossary.body: Heals {stacks} at the end of each of the carrier's turns, then decays by 1.

glossary.title: LIFESTEAL
glossary.body: For {stacks} more of the carrier's turns, every hit it lands also heals it for half the damage dealt.

glossary.title: HONED
glossary.body: All {targets} in range deal {amount} more damage.

glossary.title: SHELTERED
glossary.body: All {targets} in range take {amount} less damage.

glossary.title: BOLSTERED
glossary.body: Adds {amount} to {status} granted to all {targets} in range.

glossary.title: WARDED
glossary.body: Immune to one status at a time. Which one rotates at the end of each of this character's turns.

glossary.title: THORNS
glossary.body: Attackers take {stacks} damage whenever they hit this character. Does not wear off.

glossary.title: SPLITTING
glossary.body: Splits into two at half health, with the remaining health shared between them.

glossary.title: ESCAPING
glossary.body: Blinks to the far side of the board each time its health falls past another threshold.

glossary.title: PILFERED
glossary.body: Discards a card at random at the start of each of the next {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: SAPPED
glossary.body: 1 less energy each turn for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: INNATE
glossary.body: Always in hand. Never enters the draw or discard pile.

glossary.title: COOLDOWN
glossary.body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after it is played.

glossary.title: DORMANT
glossary.body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after you gain it.

glossary.title: INTERRUPTIBLE
glossary.body: Freezing this character while it is winding this up knocks the card out for {magnitude} turns.
